subject: Re: Project Tundra kickoff - one fine-tuning framework for every modality
body:
Lucia,

Tundra staffing and compute below.

Staffing: Ondrej 50% through the window - he owns the detection and VLM strategies (the location-tokenization path for detection and instance segmentation). Linnea 40% on framework plumbing and the strategy-pattern config layer. Carmen 40% on the text SFT track, including the Swahili translation reference task with chat templating and -100 prompt masking - it's the cleanest end-to-end demo of the text path and doubles as our i18n story.

Compute: 64 A100s on titan-a100 best effort for the hardening runs; if the ASR track needs bigger sweeps in June I'll come back with a separate ask rather than padding this one.

One watch item: ASR is our least-staffed modality. If the USM-encoder integration fights us, I'd rather slip the June 12 milestone than pull Ondrej off detection.

Daniela
